speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consult. I am Dr. Agent; please describe your newborn's specific symptoms, how they were born, and any recent changes in their condition. To begin, have there been any feeding difficulties, temperature instability, or unusual lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunization, are you noticing any signs of respiratory distress, jaundice, or poor feeding in this newborn? Please also let me know if the baby has had any specific illnesses or if there are any abnormal findings on physical exam.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The triad of cataracts, blueberry muffin rash (non-blanching purpura), and sensorineural deafness, combined with a continuous heart murmur, is pathognomonic for this condition.
